target_customer: Engineering teams with large, unoptimized GitHub Actions CI bills
problem: CI is slow and expensive, and AI coding agents produce more code than teams can verify, making verification the bottleneck.
business_model: Fixed monthly price per org for CI runners quoted from usage; AI PR review at $1 per pull request after 10 free
product_category: CI runners and AI code review

founders.name: Dan McGee
education: UC Berkeley, EECS and Business (M.E.T. program), left to found Graphide
previous_startups: Software automation business in high school (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Built Matrix, a policy simulation platform, while interning at Illumio.

founders.name: Benjamin McIntyre
prior_employers: Political campaign technology operations (employer not named)
education: University of Cincinnati, Computer Engineering and Mathematics (current)
founders.background_notes: Founded the University of Cincinnati Linux and FOSS club, which grew past 100 students.

competitors.name: Blacksmith
competitors.what: Drop in faster GitHub Actions runners
competitors.traction_then: reportedly a $1B valuation round in Oct 2026

competitors.name: Namespace
competitors.what: Fast GitHub Actions runners; ranked first on an independent x64 benchmark
competitors.traction_then: about 1.9x GitHub standard runners per benchmark

competitors.name: StarSling

technical_complexity.rationale: Owning hardware plus a code graph for selective test running and agents that tune CI is real engineering, but runner products are a known pattern.

defensibility.rationale: Runner market is crowded with funded players and switching is a one line change. Review agent competes with well known tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Graphide found. Several funded runner vendors already sell the same wedge.

market_need_then: Teams complain about GitHub hosted runner cost, and runner vendors report migrations cutting cost to a quarter in one anecdote. AI generated code raises review load.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct performance claims, states targets are not guarantees

brand_strength.rationale: A brand search returned nothing about Graphide, only similarly named Graphite and Graphisoft, which shows search confusion risk.

outcome_analysis: Graphide is a Fall 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. It enters a crowded GitHub Actions runner market with funded rivals and adds an AI review product, so it must differentiate on its graph based test selection and agent tuning rather than raw runner speed.
notes: No funding information found beyond the site claim Backed by Y Combinator. No news coverage of Graphide itself surfaced in searches. Competitor funding figures come from snippets of aggregator or news pages and were not independently cross checked. Greptile is named by the company as a review benchmark but was not researched. Completeness pass: the $125k seed is recorded from Dealroom alone (profile labeled made with AI, no date or investors visible); cross-check search found no other source.
